021/**
022 * Provides a container for managing tax rates applied to both the interactor
023 * and the owner during a transaction in the shop.
024 *
025 * This class stores and manages the tax rates for the interactor (e.g., the user
026 * interacting with the shop) and the owner (e.g., the owner of the shop).
027 * It includes methods to retrieve and modify these rates as well as to check
028 * if taxes are applied to either party.
029 *
030 * Instances of this class are primarily used to encapsulate tax rates when
031 * calculating taxes using a {@link TaxProvider}.
032 *
033 * @author creatorfromhell
034 * @since 6.2.0.11
035 */
036public class TaxRates {
037
038  private double interactorRate;
039  private double shopRate;
040
041  public TaxRates(final double interactorRate, final double shopRate) {
042
043    this.interactorRate = interactorRate;
044    this.shopRate = shopRate;
045  }
046
047  /**
048   * Checks whether a tax rate is applied to the interactor.
049   *
050   * @return true if the interactor tax rate is not 0.0, false otherwise
051   * @since 6.2.0.11
052   */
053  public boolean taxInteractor() {
054    return interactorRate != 0.0;
055  }
056
057  /**
058   * Checks whether a tax rate is applied to the shop.
059   *
060   * @return true if the shop tax rate is not 0.0, false otherwise
061   * @since 6.2.0.11
062   */
063  public boolean taxShop() {
064    return shopRate != 0.0;
065  }
066
067  public double interactorRate() {
068
069    return interactorRate;
070  }
071
072  public void interactorRate(final double interactorRate) {
073
074    this.interactorRate = interactorRate;
075  }
076
077  public double shopRate() {
078
079    return shopRate;
080  }
081
082  public void shopRate(final double shopRate) {
083
084    this.shopRate = shopRate;
085  }
086}
